claim: Sweden’s Public Health Agency presented its first national strategy against loneliness on 28 February 2025, including access to social settings and reducing barriers to participation.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: The Swedish government assigned the Food Agency to compile and share knowledge about food and meals for older people, including material for eldercare staff and decision makers.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: The Swedish government commissioned the Public Health Agency to map older people’s mental health, incorporating their own accounts of their living circumstances.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: Sweden published its adopted national dementia strategy for 2025–2028, covering development of care and support for people living with dementia.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: Sweden announced minister Anna Tenje’s visit to South Korea and Japan to discuss demographic change, eldercare and healthy ageing. This records a stated diplomatic agenda, not a new law.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: The Swedish parliament approved new tobacco rules extending smoke-free restrictions to certain outdoor public places. Most provisions began on 1 July 2019; tracking and security marking had a separate start date.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset. Tracking/security-marking provisions started 20 May 2019.

claim: Sweden’s parliament approved a requirement to offer home-care recipients a designated care contact unless clearly unnecessary, starting 1 July 2022. The professional-title requirement had a later start date.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset. The assistant-nurse title requirement started 1 July 2023.

claim: The Swedish government instructed the National Board of Health and Welfare to distribute SEK 143.5 million to municipalities for health conversations intended to counter loneliness among older people.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: Sweden’s government proposed a public-health framework addressing avoidable health inequalities within a generation. This source establishes the proposal and its goals, not parliamentary adoption.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset. A proposed start date is not an enacted effective date.

claim: Forte reported five funded projects in a NordForsk call on sustainable health and social care for older people. Forte was one of several funders; the awards span Nordic and Baltic countries.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.

claim: Sweden’s government proposed designated contacts in residential eldercare and stronger support for family carers in bill 2025/26:60. The bill proposed 1 July 2026 commencement; this document alone does not establish enactment.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset. A proposed start date is not an enacted effective date.

claim: Sweden’s Public Health Agency published recommendations for organisations working with people aged 65 and over, including involving older people in decisions and enabling meaningful daily activities.
source_note: Source date is publication or the explicitly dated decision; unknown dates remain unset.
